chapters.title: Contract the positive inverse replacement
chapters.explanation: Use the squared sphere relation to replace eighteen positive half-twist units by one inverse pair twist.

chapters.title: Restore the last two separating twists
chapters.explanation: Restore a cancelling pair and reverse the two-lantern consequence to recover the (26,2) checkpoint.

chapters.title: Undo the alternate half lantern
chapters.explanation: Restore the ordinary root, reverse the cancellation and half lantern, then return the five petals.

chapters.title: Undo the common-chart cluster lantern
chapters.explanation: Separate the matching pairs, restore the inverse pair, and reverse the {35},4,6 cluster move.

chapters.title: Open the cross-stage PC lantern
chapters.explanation: Open the transported three-point root into its three petals and reverse the gathering moves.

chapters.title: Undo the complementary petal exchange
chapters.explanation: Restore the cancelled inverse pair and reverse the two cyclic PC rose substitutions.

chapters.title: Undo the signed half-lantern compression
chapters.explanation: Expand the signed root expression back into the transported half-lantern factors.

chapters.title: Undo the residual lantern
chapters.explanation: Reintroduce the cancelled pair, transport it backward, and restore the residual roots.

chapters.title: Undo the first cluster reductions
chapters.explanation: Restore the cluster lantern and the complementary charts, retaining the lift signs.

chapters.title: Undo the prefix sphere lantern
chapters.explanation: Replace two boundary-pair twists by the transported root prefix.

chapters.title: Recover the original thirteen factors
chapters.explanation: Undo the initial consolidation, then recombine the split three-point roots.
